title: World's Greatest Train Ride Videos China VHS 1995 Sealed Publishers Choice
descriptionText:
World's Greatest Train Ride Videos: China (Publishers Choice Video, VHS NSI YG8).

A complete rail tour of China starting in Beijing - the Great Wall, the Imperial Palace and the Forbidden City, pagodas, ancient Buddhas, modern cities and traditional villages.

- Produced by France 2
- Written and directed by Francois Gall and Bernard d'Abrigeon
- Sleeve & design (c)1995 National Syndications, Inc.

Condition: factory sealed, never opened. There is a handwritten price sticker on the front of the shrink wrap, and small tears in the wrap at the bottom edge (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
